title: The AI tool that replaced 100 employees overnight

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What happens when an AI tool replaces 100 jobs in a single day, and society is unprepared?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current NLP and computer vision tools can automate tasks like data entry, customer service, and even basic legal work.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Mass displacement risks deepening inequality, with retraining programs lagging behind technological change.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are integrating AI with upskilling platforms, like Coursera and Google's AI training modules.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: In 10 years, AI could create new roles in AI maintenance, ethical oversight, and human-AI collaboration.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future will demand balance — innovation that elevates, rather than replaces, the human experience.

video_cue: A montage of workers transitioning from repetitive tasks to AI-assisted creative and analytical roles.
